title: pi built-in MCP server entry
description: Hand-authored from pi 1.0.0 dist/core/mcp-servers.d.ts (McpServerConfig). Describes one `mcpServers.<name>` entry of ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json or <cwd>/.pi/mcp.json so the dashboard client can render editors without hard-coding field lists. Annotations: x-transport marks the two mutually exclusive transports (command xor url); x-secret marks credential-bearing fields (masked in the editor, redacted when inherited, omitted from folder copies); x-global-only marks fields pi reads only from the global file. The writer additionally mirrors pi's validateMcpServerConfig rules (pi-rules.ts).

Exposure.description: How the server's tools reach the model. Default codemode. codemode-deferred is pi's legacy alias of codemode, accepted on read and preserved.

ServerEntry.description: One pi MCP server entry: stdio (command) or streamable HTTP (url).
